author: codex:engineering
context: INC-0025 showed a schema-valid final audit with one changed digest character. Existing host correctly rejected it. Structural echo is not a semantic decision.
decision: Constrain structural echo values from validated input in an additive explicit recipe. Keep semantic judgments free and host cross-reference/completeness validation strict. Record full recipe digest separately from unchanged logical report fingerprint. Validate actual saved negative response offline; do not repair or retry it.
